# Claude Code Action

> GitHub ワークフロー内で Claude Code を実行できる公式 GitHub Action。issue / PR への @claude メンション（タグモード）またはプロンプト入力（エージェントモード）に対応し、Anthropic API・AWS Bedrock・Google Vertex AI の 3 プロバイダーをサポートする。

## Guide

- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/base-action/CLAUDE.md): - Build/Type check: bun run typecheck - Format code: bun run format - Check formatting: bun run format:check - Run tests: bun test - Install dependenc…

- [⚠️ This is a Mirror Repository](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/base-action/MIRROR_DISCLAIMER.md): This repository is an automated mirror of the base-action directory from anthropics/claude-code-action.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): A GitHub Action that lets Claude respond to @claude mentions on issues/PRs (tag mode) or run tasks via prompt input (agent mode).
- [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.
- [Capabilities and Limitations](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/capabilities-and-limitations.md): - Respond in a Single Comment: Claude operates by updating a single initial comment with progress and results - Answer Questions: Analyze code and pro…
- [Cloud Providers](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/cloud-providers.md): You can authenticate with Claude using any of these four methods:

- [Custom Automations](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/custom-automations.md): These examples show how to configure Claude to act automatically based on GitHub events.

- [Migration Guide: v0.x to v1.0](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md): This guide helps you migrate from Claude Code Action v0.x to v1.0.
- [Security](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/security.md): - Repository Access: The action can only be triggered by users with write access to the repository - Bot User Control: By default, GitHub Apps and bots cannot trigger this action for security reasons.
